rv.q: Dear Evan Hansen is a show that holds you tight with its honesty of story told in a way that delights you to your very toes.
La Mirada's production, to put it in the simplest terms, is just absolutely outstanding all around—from its vocal and acting performances to its modern production design...
Dear Evan Hansen at the La Mirada Theatre makes it well worth the wait.
“Dear Evan Hansen” is musical storytelling of the highest caliber, a work of exemplary intelligence and a committed embrace of deep feeling flowing from a compelling, Tony Award-winning score.
This is, hands down, the finest production of Dear Evan Hansen I’ve seen.
Each song is fulfilling and masterly woven into the narrative of this amazing musical: making for a stellar cast album.
Competently helmed by director/choreographer Stephen C. Anthony and musical director Ryan O'Connell, DEAR EVAN HANSEN presents the life of a loner with compassion.

cn.t: Critics widely praise Dear Evan Hansen for its emotionally powerful story and near-perfect score, calling it one of the most compelling musicals of its era. Reception is overwhelmingly positive across productions.
